name: Tsukishima Nagi
source:
She works as a deck woman on the ship. She is a cheerful girl. Her job is to serve the guests and lend her hand to carry their luggage and other tasks as well. 

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=66661]Getchu's website[/url].]
